Bug_Title: Classes that don't define "hashCode()" should not be used in hashes
Bug_Explanation: The Student class defines an equals(Object) method but does not define a hashCode() method. This causes issues when Student objects are used as keys in a Hashtable, as equivalent Student objects can have different hash codes, leading to unexpected behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method of the School class, which uses a Hashtable with Student objects as keys. Since the Student class does not define a hashCode() method, equivalent Student objects can have different hash codes, leading to unexpected behavior in the Hashtable. This results in the test case failing due to the incorrect behavior of the Hashtable.
